title: I Am God (The Amazing Digital Circus)
blurb: Grandiosity delivered without a flicker of doubt. Inside The Amazing Digital Circus the management genuinely can rewrite the world around you, so a claim like this sits somewhere between a boast and a plain description of the arrangement. Glitch Productions put the pilot on YouTube in late 2023 and watched it become one of the biggest animated debuts the platform has ever handled. Quotable lines were a large part of why. This one gets deployed after minor victories: a solved bug, a won argument, a parking space secured against the odds.
origin: A line from The Amazing Digital Circus (Glitch Productions, 2023).
